rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (4 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guts_(album), https://nailcityrecord.com/en-ca/products/olivia-rodrigo-guts-the-secret-tracks-rsd-black-friday-2023-purple-ep-vinyl. RSD Black Friday 2023 vinyl-exclusive EP via Third Man Records/Geffen. Collects the four secret bonus tracks from the GUTS vinyl variants. Limited to 7,500 copies. All four tracks later included on the GUTS (Spilled) deluxe edition.
